note: Built from the official trophy descriptions only. No trophy is confirmed permanently missable yet — the six flagged as missable involve one-time moments or setups, so do them when the chance appears.

stages.blurb: Play the main story from Gone Fishing through the final mission. Chapters 1 to 4 and the named story missions all land here, and the platinum's story half is done by the end.
stages.name: Stage 1 — Story first
stages.tip: Do not rush past the missables in this stage: Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Catch Me If You Can and Capital Offense all need a moment that may not come back.

stages.blurb: Work the strangers of Leonida. Eight full strands earns Strangers & Freaks, and each strand's final mission is its own trophy. Bret's hunt and the meditation spots fit here too.
stages.name: Stage 2 — Strangers of Leonida
stages.tip: Stranger icons on the map show who still has work. Finish a strand the moment it opens so nothing is left hanging.

stages.blurb: The skill grind: shooting range golds, races, stunts, fishing, the arcade and the challenge list. These stack up while you play, so start them early and finish them here.
stages.name: Stage 3 — Activities and skills
stages.tip: The Shootist's 42 gold medals are the longest grind in this stage — visit a range every time you pass one.

stages.blurb: See the whole state. Cards, WAiNK tags, vehicles, and every region of the map. Exploration trophies are the most relaxing part of the hunt.
stages.name: Stage 4 — Collect and explore
stages.tip: Pair WAiNK tags and vehicle discoveries with normal travel — every new area is progress on three trophies at once.

stages.blurb: The money stage: vaults, trucks, gang ops, laundering, shopping and property. Then check the stats page and mop up whatever is left for 100% — and the platinum.
stages.name: Stage 5 — Money and mop-up
stages.tip: Launder Marked Bills after every big score. By the time the vaults are done, Dime on the Dollar is usually close behind.
